text: I discontinued the newsletter as the pressure to keep it engaging led to burnout. The constant need to produce fresh content took a toll on my creativity, leaving me feeling drained and uninspired. I found myself spending late nights trying to come up with innovative ways to present market information to my subscribers. Over time, it became less about my passion for the subject and more about meeting deadlines, which diluted the quality of what I was sharing. Realizing this, I took a step back and decided to pursue journaling about market trends instead, as it aligns much more with my interests and allows me to express my thoughts without the constraints of an audience.
